data.name: Red Soil
data.detailed_description:
Red Soil is an isometric top-down gritty survival horror game set in the scorched outback of Australia where you’ll battle not just the undead — but the land itself. Every step drains your stamina. Every hour brings thirst, hunger, and fatigue. The heat is relentless. The silence is never safe.

Core Features:

  • Dynamic Survival Maps – Explore procedurally activated environments where no two runs are the same.

  • Undead & Environmental Threats – Face infected enemies while managing heat, thirst, hunger, and exhaustion.

  • Mission & Free-Roam Modes – Progress through structured missions or test your endurance in randomized survival runs.

  • Character Progression – Level up your survivor, unlock specialized skills, and tailor your playstyle.

  • Crafting & Equipment – Scavenge resources to craft weapons, tools, and survival gear.

  • Resource Management – Balance hydration, nutrition, and stamina to stay alive.

  • Atmospheric Presentation – Gritty isometric visuals and immersive soundscapes that capture the harsh Australian outback.

Red Soil demands more than reflexes — it demands discipline. Equip wisely. Move deliberately. Adapt constantly. In Red Soil, survival isn’t given. It’s earned.

data.short_description: Survive the heat and the undead in this isometric horror game set in the Australian outback. Manage stamina, hydration, hunger, and fatigue while exploring random maps, leveling up, crafting gear, and to fight in the heat of the day or the darkness of night.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 3Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: g

content_descriptors.notes:
The player will attack undead in hand-to-hand combat using clubs/knives/spears etc.
There are no blood or dismemberment effects during combat.
The enemy models have been selected to depict undead and therefore contain elements of gore.
Some static gore may be present for atmospheric purposes.
As the game is top-down isometric, all gore is viewed at a distance.
The games icon depicts an undead animal in a cartoon style.
